mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates by reducing risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as capital shifts from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as revenue expectations fall.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95 indicates manufacturing supply chain disruption, causing elevated inflation and margin pressure that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) signal improving consumer confidence and residential investment, consistently driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days as growth sentiment strengthens.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of rising HOUST periods, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% triggers hawkish monetary policy expectations, causing bond yield spikes that contract equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll decline (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 combined with GDP growth below 1.0% annualized signals recessionary supply conditions, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days due to margin pressure and investment cuts.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 growth < 1.0%, or joint condition Rank IC < 0.05.
